prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1405; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact, and the presenting complaint involved the right knee. Over the course of care, the patient attended 22 visits for evaluation and rehabilitation. Treatment followed a typical progression, beginning with conservative measures including physical therapy, activity modification, and anti-inflammatory medication, and frequency of visits tapered as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Examination findings were mixed: several orthopedic tests reproduced knee pain and showed mild effusion, supporting the reported injury, while other ligamentous and neurovascular assessments returned within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to this body area. Billed services were reviewed and each reflects a distinct, medically indicated encounter with no duplicate charges identified. Patient was discharged to home exercise program with instructions for follow-up as needed.
